protocol.target: Glucose >=180 mg/dL at exactly +120 minutes; overlapping windows, not unique episodes.

routines.title: Daily timing changes and skipped meals

protocol.history: V3 24h history plus available matured V3 forecast residuals; no future target values, clocks or routine labels as inputs.
protocol.classifierSelection: Minimize worst FP/FN count ratio against frozen V3 across overall, irregular and variable-routine selection windows; one global threshold; mean ratio then AP tie break.
protocol.regressionSelection: Lowest selection +120-minute MAE from predeclared HGB/ExtraTrees residual blends; earlier horizons remain the frozen V3 forecast.
protocol.calibration: 48 new identities fit Platt mapping; separate 48 identities choose global policy and residual bands.
protocol.finalGate: No IDs >=4000 or held-out combination generated before frozen estimator, calibrator, threshold, bands and protocol are SHA-256 recorded.
protocol.promotionGate: Both FP and FN lower than V3 in primary, variable and held-out groups, with primary paired FN/FP 95% intervals entirely below zero; no automatic promotion.
limitations: Synthetic experiment only, separate from open-research model evaluation.
Unannounced future meals remain partly unpredictable.
Personalization only uses already resolved historical forecasts; it does not fit on future test outcomes.
Routine families appear in training; one new factor combination is held out.
